name: altuu/plugin-alt-uu-plus
description: NativePHP in-app purchase bridge for subscription entitlement (StoreKit 2 / Play Billing)

bridge_functions.name: AltUUPlus.FetchProducts
bridge_functions.description: Fetch localized product/price info for the configured subscription product identifiers

bridge_functions.name: AltUUPlus.Purchase
bridge_functions.description: Start the native purchase flow for a product identifier and return the resulting transaction

bridge_functions.name: AltUUPlus.RestorePurchases
bridge_functions.description: Re-surface the user's existing purchases/entitlements from the platform store

bridge_functions.name: AltUUPlus.CurrentEntitlements
bridge_functions.description: Return the transactions/purchases currently granting entitlement on this device
